html:
Joyce Banda was president of Malawi from 2012 to 2014, the first woman to lead the country and the first in southern Africa.

A businesswoman and campaigner for women's rights and girls' education, she was elected vice president in 2009 and broke with President Bingu wa Mutharika. When he died suddenly in April 2012, she took office under the constitution, despite attempts by his allies to block her.

She devalued the currency and sold the presidential jet, but her term was hit by the Cashgate scandal, in which officials stole large sums from the state. She lost the election of 2014. Her rise showed the strength of the constitution won in the referendum of 1993 and changed the place of women in politics in Malawi, after the decades of Hastings Banda.
sum: Joyce Banda was president of Malawi from 2012 to 2014, the first woman to lead the country and the first in southern Africa.
